services_heading: Complete Refurbishment & Maintenance Services Across Nottingham
services_subhead: From small repairs to full property renovations, Smart Tradesman delivers quality workmanship across every corner of your home.

services.title: Full House Refurbishment
services.desc: We manage complete property transformations from start to finish, coordinating all trades to modernise your home with minimal disruption and outstanding results.

services.title: Kitchen Fitting & Renovation
services.desc: Whether you need a brand-new kitchen installed or an existing one refreshed, we handle everything from unit fitting to tiling and finishing touches.

services.title: Bathroom Refurbishment
services.desc: From a simple suite swap to a full wet room conversion, we deliver clean, watertight bathroom renovations that stand the test of time.

services.title: Plastering & Rendering
services.desc: Smooth walls and solid surfaces are the foundation of any great finish — our plastering work is tidy, even, and ready to decorate every time.

services.title: Painting & Decorating
services.desc: We prepare surfaces properly before a single coat goes on, ensuring a flawless finish that gives every room a fresh, lasting look.

services.title: General Property Maintenance
services.desc: Leaky gutters, draughty doors, cracked paving — we handle all those jobs on your list quickly and professionally so your property stays in top condition.

about_pullquote: We take pride in every job, however big or small it may be.
about_para_1: Smart Tradesman was founded in Nottingham with a simple goal: deliver honest, high-quality refurbishment and maintenance work that homeowners can rely on. Over the years we've built a strong local reputation by turning up when we say we will, communicating clearly, and finishing every job to a standard we're genuinely proud of.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is our attention to detail and our commitment to treating every customer's home with the same care we'd give our own. Our clients return to us time and again — and regularly recommend us to friends and neighbours across Nottingham — because they know they'll always get straightforward advice, fair pricing, and excellent results.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Smart Tradesman

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant service from start to finish. The team refurbished our bathroom and the results are stunning. Tidy, professional, and finished ahead of schedule. Would highly recommend to anyone in Nottingham.
reviews.author: Claire B.

reviews.text: Used Smart Tradesman for a full kitchen renovation and couldn't be happier. Great communication throughout, no hidden costs, and the quality of the work is first class. Will definitely be using them again.
reviews.author: James T.

reviews.text: Called them out to sort a list of maintenance jobs I'd been putting off for months. Everything was done efficiently and to a really high standard. Friendly, reliable, and excellent value for money.
